Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of labor and industries to develop recommendations on a contractor registration program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to contractor registration qualifications; addinga new section to chapter 18.27 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that a significant cause of the problemsconsumers face in residential construction is poor workmanship. Thelegislature further finds that one of the most effective methods forprotecting consumers in the area of residential construction is toensure that contractors have the experience and skills necessary tomanage all aspects of a construction project. The legislature,therefore, intends to establish education, experience, and examinationrequirements for contractors. (2)(a) The department of labor and industries shall developrecommendations to the legislature on the education, experience, andexamination requirements for the contractor registration program. (b) In developing recommendations, the department shall closelyinvolve and consult with stakeholders. The department must also survey p. 1 HB 2978education, experience, and examination requirements in other states,particularly states such as California that require trade specificcompetency training. (c) The recommendations must be submitted to the appropriatecommittees of the legislature by December 15, 2010. (3) This section expires June 30, 2011.
